item.title: Status yellow fog warning in effect across Shannonside region
item.description: A status yellow fog warning is in effect for 17 counties until 10 o'clock this morning. They include Carlow, Kildare, Kilkenny, Laois, Longford, Meath, Offaly, Westmeath, Cavan, Clare, Limerick, Cork, Tipperary, Waterford, Galway, Leitrim, and Roscommon. Met Éireann says areas of dense or freezing fog are possible, leading to impaired visibility and hazardous travelling conditions. The fog will clear gradually, followed by bright or sunny spells and occasional showers. Advertisement

item.title: Teenager killed in Co. Galway crash
item.description: A teenager has been killed in a crash in County Galway. It happened outside Loughrea in the early hours of this morning. Emergency services were called to the scene of a single-car collision at Moyleen on the N65 Loughrea to Ballinasloe road at about 2.20 this morning. A man in his late teens, who was travelling in the car, was pronounced dead at the scene. His body has been removed to Portiuncula Hospital for a post-mortem exam. item.title: Longford Records Higher Rates of House Price Inflation Than National Average
item.description: Longford is experiencing higher rates of house price inflation than elsewhere in the country. That's according to a Property Price Guide out in the Sunday Times this morning, revealing house prices across the country are expected to rise by 5 point 3 per cent this year. Longford is one of the most affordable locations to buy a house in Ireland, but estate agents are expecting price increases of 10 per cent across the county. item.title: Local minister revealed to be highest-earning TD in the region
item.description: Minister for Enterprise and local politician Peter Burke has been revealed to be the highest-earning TD in the region. The Irish Independent reports a gross yearly salary of just over €212,000 for the Longford-Westmeath TD. Ministers of State Frank Feighan, Marian Harkin, Robert Troy and Kevin 'Boxer' Moran all receive €164,000 annually. item.title: Public views sought on proposed swimming pool in Athlone
item.description: Westmeath County Council is seeking public views on a proposed outdoor swimming pool and riverside boardwalk in Athlone. The project would see new recreational facilities developed along the River Shannon. An online survey will launch next week to gather feedback from residents and stakeholders. The plans are being examined as part of a broader feasibility and design process. According to the council, public input will help guide the future development of the project. Advertisement

item.title: Roscommon Drama Festival to place from March 6th to 14th
item.description: Roscommon Drama Festival takes place from March 6th to 14th this year. Tickets are now on sale from Roscommon Arts Centre, online or from members of the committee. The festival's PRO says the festival provides a boost to the local economy. Advertisement Groups travel from all across Ireland for the event with many staying in Roscommon during the week. Jimmy Hoban says the committee is hard at work ahead of opening night: Advertisement

item.title: Live Updates: St. Brigid's v Dingle
item.description: Follow live updates of the All-Ireland club football final as St. Brigid's face Dingle in Croke Park. St. Brigid's edged out Scotstown in the semi-final. Whereas, Dingle stunned favourites Ballyboden St. Enda's in their semi-final with a two-point win. Roscommon and Connacht champions Brigid's make their fourth All-Ireland final appereance having won in 2013. Whereas, Dingle are making their first apperance at this stage. Advertisement Throw-in is 3:40pm.

item.title: Leitrim open Lidl league with victory
item.description: The 2026 Lidl National Football League got under way on Sunday with four games in Division 4 of the competition. Six players found the net as Leitrim, one of the promotion favourites, ousted neighbours Longford by 6-17 to 2-10 at Glennon Brothers Pearse Park. Leitrim, with goals from Vivienne Egan, Leah Fox and Kate Gormley, led 3-5 to 1-6 at the interval.
